name: QWEN-E0-SPEC-CENSUS-0
note: Frozen 2026-10-17 BEFORE any smoke output of scratch/qwen_e0_spec_census.py was read. Greedy law only: acceptance is top-1 equality at the same teacher-greedy context. Teacher token = the recorded rollout token; fp16-stored argmax and ulp bound are reported separately and define the ambiguous set, which is excluded from certification only. FENCES: teacher-forced, no generation, no rollback; nothing here measures throughput | single arm, 24 prompts, Mac CPU, fp16-stored teacher logits | ambiguous positions (recorded token != fp16 argmax, or stored margin <= one ulp) stay in bars 1 and 2 and are excluded from bar 3 | smoke (one prompt, 8 steps) is instrument-only; its agreement numbers are not read before this registration is committed

C.description: arm C (compile chain logs/qwenwhole/artifact_digest_C.txt), streamed CPU reference, teacher-forced over the 24 preserved greedy rollouts of logs/qwenteacher_v2 (pin 0ca4151, revision 1d4bf0f2)

bars.name: GREEDY-ACCEPT
bars.description: pooled P(draft argmax == recorded teacher token) over all live rollout positions >= 0.75 (teacher-forced corpus proxy was 0.829; the bar allows a 0.08 context-distribution loss)

bars.name: REPLAY-K4
bars.description: empirical accepted-prefix replay, k = 4, pooled over the 24 streams in prompt order: mean emitted tokens per verify block >= 2.5 (break-even under the August Mac CPU costs needs > 2.02; 2.5 leaves room for cost error)

bars.name: CERTIFIED-QUARTER
bars.description: fraction of non-ambiguous positions where the shift-aligned sup error is below (stored margin - one fp16 ulp)/2 >= 0.25; this is the share of positions where agreement is a theorem, not a coincidence

refuted_if: min_bar12_ratio = min(agree_rate_pooled / 0.75, replay_pooled.4.mean_emitted / 2.5) below 1.0, i.e. bar 1 NO-FIRE or bar 2 NO-FIRE: this arm has no realistic greedy-speculation path on the Mac; bar 3 alone decides nothing
registered_prior: bar 1 fires near 0.80; bar 2 lands between 2.6 and 3.4 (the independence model at 0.80 gives 3.36, and streams are expected to be positively correlated in failures, which lowers the replay); bar 3 is a coin flip because the sup error of a 2-bit tower was never measured
